in_hebrew.name: Freda
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Freda הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word ‘frēdēr’, meaning ‘peaceful’ or ‘protector’. In ancient Greece, the name Freda was given to girls born to noble families, symbolizing their role as protectors and rulers of their households.
